about: Speedboats: a big V8 inboard by throttle, its start and revs, spray at speed and the hull slamming on waves; the rest falls back to core:boat.
notes: v3 (vehicle round). Engine layers are 20 s beds cut to loop, played faster or slower by rpm; slot names match core:vehicle's, so a vehicle of this family is heard by them first and by core:vehicle for the rest.

prompts.text: A powerful speedboat's big V8 inboard engine idles at the dock: a deep lumpy rumbling burble through wet exhausts with water gurgling, constant. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/low.want: the V8 inboard at low revs

prompts.text: A powerful speedboat cruises slowly: a deep throaty V8 rumble with water gurgling at the exhaust, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/mid.want: the V8 inboard at middle revs

prompts.text: A powerful speedboat runs at speed: a loud deep V8 roar and rushing water, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/high.want: the V8 inboard at full power

prompts.text: A powerful speedboat runs flat out: a thunderous howling V8 roar with water hissing past, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/start.want: the starter and the V8 barking into life

prompts.text: A speedboat's big V8 engine is started: the starter cranks, the engine fires with a loud rumbling bark and settles into a lumpy burbling idle, two separate starts with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A speedboat's big V8 engine is revved hard in neutral: a loud rising roar and a falling burble, four separate revs with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

hull/fast.want: spray and water roaring past at speed

prompts.text: A speedboat planes fast over the sea: a roaring rush of water and hissing spray against the hull with wind, steady. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

slam.want: the hull slamming down off a wave

prompts.text: A speedboat at speed jumps a wave and slams down hard: a loud hollow bang of the hull and a heavy burst of spray, four separate slams with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
